sloka: भाग्यवैषम्ययोगेन पुरादुश्चरितेन च ।मयैतत् प्राप्यते सर्वं स्वकृतं ह्युपभुज्यते ।। ६.११६.४० ।।
transliteration: bhāgyavaiṣamyayogena purāduścaritena ca ।mayaitat prāpyate sarvaṁ svakṛtaṁ hyupabhujyate ।। 6.116.40 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman having spoken like that, Sita who was fond of the desperate, thus spoke to Hanuman thinking for a while.
